outcome: Three-process standalone consumer passed real persisted queued schedule/manual exclusions, exact durable Start missing-link recovery and late replay preserving the newer trigger.
boundary: Real Engine and SQLite state, native disposable local Git, signed admission; controlled WorkflowPort. No native Lattice workload, HTTPS listener or host qualification.

recipe.instructions: Create an out-of-tree package with these source files; adjust only repository paths in Cargo.toml to the checkout under verification. Copy its root Cargo.lock into the disposable package; run run.sh with Rust 1.88, existing native pkg-config/OpenSSL environment and a private, initially absent runtime directory. The native Git helper explicitly bypasses global config and signing.

files.run.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Parent-only build/run entrypoint. This worker has NOT executed this script.
# Source package is outside the checkout; state is disposable and unique.
package=/tmp/kiln-origin-consumer.d7avmz1J
state="$package/runtime"
if [[ -e "$state" ]]; then
  printf 'Refusing to reuse existing runtime state: %s\n' "$state" >&2
  exit 1
fi
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-/home/brittonr/.cargo-target}"
"${CARGO:-cargo}" build --offline --manifest-path "$package/Cargo.toml"
binary="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug/kiln-origin-consumer"
"$binary" prepare "$state" | tee "$package/prepare-output.json"
"$binary" deliver "$state" | tee "$package/deliver-output.json"
"$binary" verify "$state" | tee "$package/verify-output.json"
printf 'Receipt: %s\n' "$state/receipt.json"
# Intentionally retain this unique /tmp tree for parent evidence handoff.
# Once receipt/output is archived, parent may remove this exact staging tree.

receipt.boundary: Real Engine, native local Git source, signed trigger admission, durable on-disk state, three separate consumer processes. Controlled WorkflowPort only; no real Lattice, HTTPS listener, workload execution or host confinement qualification.
